name: Hiiragi Sara
source:
The fanatically loyal follower of Kurojou-gumi and by extension Kensei's most devoted fan.

She is the youngest of the feared Hiiragi duo, known as formidable enforcers of the Kurojou-gumi. 

She willingly serves as both Kensei's sword and shield. Her extreme loyalty drives her to eliminate anyone who dares to stand in his way, no matter who they are.

Part of Kurojou-gumi
